events.title: “In Full Swing:" The Historical Roots of Pennsylvania Politics
events.venue: Carpenter’s Hall, 320 Chestnut St, Philadelphia, PA 19106
events.description:
In 1776 Carpenters’ Hall stood at the crossroads of the geographic and demographic tensions driving Pennsylvania politics, and today Pennsylvania is one of the nation’s most important electoral “swing” states. As we approach another consequential midterm election, join us to explore the historical roots of Pennsylvania’s divided politics, how they still resonate today, and how and where we can find common ground.
